verdict.rationale: The evidence shows accounts can have custom fields, and those fields can be used for filtering and sorting when searching people. Smart Lists act as saved lead views, but this filtering and sorting is documented only at the API level, not as a no-code ops workflow. Missing for 10: evidence that ops users can create custom fields themselves without admin work, a UI view builder with filter and sort controls, shared views across the team, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project

citations.quote: If the account has custom fields defined, you can also filter on these when searching for a person.
Custom Fields (e.g. `customClosePrice`) can also be used in sorting.
Search for people that match a smart list with given ID.
